scope: complete published clips; approximately constant annotated pulse
source_representation: original published 128-band log-mel spectrogram, stored float16
constant_fit_policy: ordinary least squares on every original annotated beat; no outlier removal or prediction input
meter_policy: compare annotated pulses per bar with the predicted numerator; notation denominator is not certified
pulse_note_value_policy: reference-informed unit diagnostic treats each annotation pulse as a quarter; this is not independent notation truth
unit_hint_policy: fitted reference pulse BPM selects only a discrete unit after all audio families are prepared
pilot_selection: deterministic round robin over genre and annotated bar-pulse-count strata; one representative per exact feature group
grouping: exact published feature identity; no claim of complete recording or artist identity
